about.title: About
bio: I'm a software developer who understands how businesses run. I care about the work behind the screen: how an order moves from the counter to the books, how stock gets counted, how a report lands on a manager's desk.

Most of my projects start with a process that eats too much time. I map it, simplify it, then build the website, dashboard or ERP module that runs it. Production, sales, procurement and finance are the areas I know best.
I work across the stack and I'm used to leading a small team, keeping the plan clear and the client in the loop from the first call to launch.

approach.title: Understand the business
approach.desc: We start with how your team works today: who does what, where time gets lost, which numbers matter.

approach.title: Map the process

approach.title: Build and connect
approach.desc: The website, dashboard or ERP module gets built, linked to the data you already have, and tested with real cases.

approach.title: Launch and improve
approach.desc: Your team gets documentation and a walkthrough, and the system keeps improving from real use.

items.q: How much does a project cost?
items.a: It depends on the scope. After our first call I send a written estimate with scope, timeline and price, so you see the number before any work starts.

items.q: What happens on the first call?
items.a: We spend 30 minutes on your business: what slows your team down and what you want to build. I ask a lot of questions. You leave with an honest view of whether I'm the right fit.

items.q: Do you work with clients outside Indonesia?
items.a: Yes. I already work with teams across different time zones, mostly over Google Meet and chat.
Websites, web apps and business software such as ERP screens, finance tools, POS and e-invoicing. I can also lead a small team to ship it.

items.q: What's the best way to reach you?
items.a: For a new project, book a call above. For a quick question, WhatsApp is fastest. Email works best for anything with files attached.
